acceptance.end_to_end_gate: inconclusive; same-binary control exceeds the 3%/5% thresholds
acceptance.twenty_cycle_method: virtual clock or explicit maintenance time; validates buffer/container/index release, not a real-process 20-cycle RSS trace

prior_full_workspace_functional_tests.note: before final follow-ups; do not add these counts to the latest targeted run

validation.workspace_clippy: completed with existing warnings; strict -D warnings not clean

native_synthetic.scope: Native synthetic in-process workload; counted System allocator on both builds. RSS and CPU include the entire harness process; throughput/latency cover the named hot loop, excluding setup. Log legacy path mirrors old GUI row preparation; no GPU rendering. No production capacity claim.

initial_end_to_end.variant: initial adaptive copy state machine, before interrupted-I/O/shutdown follow-ups; not a final-binary certification
initial_end_to_end.method: Alternating paired trials; flip before/after and scenario-family order each pair. Each child runs one round. Aggregate medians of round metrics, not pooled latency quantiles. Local Python loopback load only; no TUN, external encrypted peers or production-capacity claim. Resource metrics come from hosted trials only.
